text: The psychological model of cognitive dissonance proposed by Leon Festinger describes the mental discomfort experienced when individuals hold contradictory beliefs or values. This theory has been influential in understanding consumer behavior, social attitudes, and decision-making processes. In database systems, this concept can be linked to the principle of data integrity, where conflicting or inconsistent data entries create a state of "dissonance" that must be resolved through validation rules or normalization processes to ensure accuracy.
